faq.a: Airboat 09 is a vehicle listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki, made in game by Airgator Airboats. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Airboat 09 as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Airboat 09?
faq.a: The wiki gives 2 details. Manufacturer: Airgator Airboats. Body style: Airboat. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Airboat 09 information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Airboat 09, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Airboat 09?
faq.a: Most of it. Airboat 09 rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Top speed, handling and stats and a gta 6 price are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Airboat 09 be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of vehicle entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
